title: eremophila sargentii
intro: Eremophila sargentii, commonly known as Sargent's Emu Bush, is a flowering plant native to Western Australia. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may aid in soothing skin irritations and infections. The therapeutic actions of Eremophila sargentii include its ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit antioxidant activity. The bioactive constituents of this plant include iridoid glycosides, such as sargentin and pholidone, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
